about: The numbers of the world around the drains, all of them open to tuning after play. Kinds says how many of a hundred drains hold a common or an uncommon keeper on a day, and how many of a hundred are the home of a rare one for a week. Crate parts are the parts a crate gives by the need of the drain, from a drain that rests to one nobody looked at for two weeks or ever. Distances are in metres, times in seconds, angles in degrees. The veil's origin is a corner south west of the town from which its squares are counted.
